instrument: Ordinance 2026-01, data center amendment to the Unified Development Code (June 2, 2026)
summary: Adopted 3-1 on June 2, 2026: "edge" data centers on lots of 50 acres or less are allowed only as special uses in four districts; "hyperscale" data centers (over 50 acres) are unlawful in the city. The final version eliminated an earlier hyperscale classification capped at 200 acres.

source.citation: City of Statesboro council minutes, June 2, 2026; Statesboro Herald (quoting the definition)

notes: The definition is by lot size, not megawatts. The Burkhalter Road project is on 26.49 acres; its 99 MW figure is from a Georgia Power supply application, not the ordinance.
confidence_note: Read in the city council minutes; ordinance text not read.
